items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Dave Capp was the A and R man; he was sort of stuck with it at this point. The sales department didn't want any part of that and Dave had to fight for it.

ctx.x: So we came in and did "Doodletown Fifers" and a couple of other things, about four things we had to do the first session and Dave Capp was the A and R man; he was sort of stuck with it at this point. The sales department didn't want any part of that and Dave had to fight for it.

So eventually it was released, and when it was released the disc jockeys picked right up on it and we became one of the proverbial "overnight things", which I wish hadn't happened, because it put us out on the road, where we immediately began to lose money that we didn't have in the first place. Although we waited a year to do it.
